title: History Browser date picker substracts one day (Android 14)
symptom: When selecting a date in the History Browser date picker and pressing OK, the date shown is one day prior to the selected date. The issue also occurs in other date pickers, such as when inserting a CGM sensor from the Action tab.
cause: The issue is a bug in Google's material-components library, triggered when the phone timezone is set to GMT-5 (e.g., EST).
fix: A workaround was implemented in commit 50a3fe0f5ef367b1ad1c8cc700ab6d439623b217.
evidence_quote: it seems to be a bug in google's library. Reported https://github.com/material-components/material-components-android/issues/4373
